name: dumbbell poliquin lateral raise
description: A lateral raise variation with a slight forward lean that hits the side delts with extra range.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, standing with a slight forward lean.
Start with the dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing in.
Raise your arms out and up in a slight arc until about shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and keep your wrists neutral.
